lost_flock.title: The Lost Flock
lost_flock.description: Find Shepherd Fluff's three sheep that bolted the night the water came, somewhere in the drowned fields.

festival_lanterns.title: Father's Rounds
festival_lanterns.description: Light the five lamps on the wharf that the lamplighter never got to, the night he didn't come home.

lost_cat.title: The Captain's Cat
lost_cat.description: Find Crumple, Corrugate's paper cat, somewhere up the cranes on the Shadow Wharf.

shadow_show.title: The Shadow Show
shadow_show.description: Perform in the Lanternfold shadow-puppet theater and win the crowd.

restring_spine.title: Restring the Spine
restring_spine.description: Find Old Bindwell's three spools of bookbinding thread on the climb up the spine.
